# @pdf-lib/fontkit

- Version: `1.1.1`, pinned in the Document workspace and root lockfile.
- License: MIT (published package metadata and
  [upstream README license](https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit#license)).
- Source: [Hopding/fontkit](https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit), the fontkit fork used
  by pdf-lib for Unicode custom-font embedding and subsetting.
- Use: Document searchable PDF text layer. Font files are fetched/checked separately
  under the existing fixed Noto / OFL font distribution contract; generated font
  bytes and PDF exports are excluded from Git.
